why: This item is a definition plus witnesses. A (universes at 0) is isTameBranched_zero ∧ isTameBranched_indicator ∧ hasTameInducedStructure_of_degIndex_eq_zero: two satisfiability witnesses of IsTameBranched and a sufficient condition for a tame induced structure. B says (a) the project's IsTameBranched agrees with the text's tame Θ (IsTameB) for branched Θ, and (b) the sheets are manifolds with boundary with corners. The definitions, project ⇒ B, are proved (isTameB_of_isTameBranched, B_def_forward_holds, rt_check OK). A NaturalRep gives B's IsNatAction with Φ(g⁻¹) as the inverse, and the properness property and tame sheets carry over. B ⇒ project is not proved. B's natural action does not ask U(x) to be connected; the project's NaturalRep does. Passing to a connected U' ⊆ U(x) (theorem_7_1_13, HasPropernessProperty.mono, LocalBranchingStructure.restrict) needs a tame induced structure on Mᵢ ∩ U'. That lemma (tameness restricts to open pieces) is not in the project. This part is believed true and is effort only. (b), 'in particular every Mᵢ is a manifold with boundary with corners', is not in A at all; the project lists it as not formalized. That is a genuine content gap, so A ⇒ B fails beyond effort. B_to_A re-proves A's three theorems outright, as copies of the project's proofs (theorem_7_1_13, localBranchingStructure_indicator.restrict, hasPropernessProperty_trivial, hasCornerStructure_of_degIndex_eq_zero, HasCornerStructure.isTame). A's witnesses are content B lacks, B's (b) is content A lacks, hence incomparable.
B_issue: B's IsNatAction drops the connectedness of U(x) that the project's NaturalRep (Theorem 7.1) carries; the blind author flags this. The two readings should define the same tame Θ, but only the project ⇒ B half of (a) is definitional.
overlap: B_to_A: 1059 shared project theorems, all from the copied witnesses: the Theorem 7.1 construction (theorem_7_1_13 / NatRepConstruction), localBranchingStructure_indicator and restrict, hasPropernessProperty_trivial, hasCornerStructure_of_degIndex_eq_zero, HasCornerStructure.isTame, rnPolyfold_degIndex, and their M-polyfold dependencies. No banned theorem is used. B_def_forward_holds uses only NaturalRep / TameBranchingStructure fields.
